mechanism: Isocarboxazid (MAOI) inhibits monoamine oxidase, increasing sympathomimetic and serotonergic activity, while nalmefene is an opioid antagonist that can cause acute withdrawal syndrome and potentiate hypertensive crisis through sympathomimetic pathways.
action: Avoid concurrent use or use with extreme caution; if necessary, educate patient on hypertensive crisis symptoms and monitor blood pressure closely; ensure washout period of 14 days before switching from MAOI.
